questions.explain: This is a massive boost for our 'Make in India' defense initiative. Located in Gujarat, this facility is going to be a game-changer because it moves missile production into the hands of private players, which is a big leap forward from the traditional state-run units.

questions.q: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced a new 'Green Deposit Framework' for NBFCs. What is the primary objective here?
questions.explain: Think of it as eco-friendly banking. The RBI wants to ensure that when you put your money into these deposits, it's actually being lent to projects like solar energy or electric vehicles, rather than anything that harms the environment.

questions.q: Which Indian athlete was recently awarded the prestigious 'Global Sports Ambassador' title for their role in promoting athletics in schools?
questions.explain: Neeraj isn't just about throwing javelins anymore! His commitment to getting kids interested in sports has earned him this global recognition. He's really become the face of Indian sportsmanship on the international stage.

questions.q: In October 2025, the 'Operation Kavach' was in the news. What is the core focus of this security exercise?
questions.explain: Sometimes it's easy to confuse these operation names! Operation Kavach is all about the fight against the illegal drug trade. It's a massive, coordinated effort to clean up cities and secure our borders from narcotics trafficking.
